propositions: New blocking check p10_verification_presence requires leaf plans to have a Testing/Verification section or at least one AC item with backtick-fenced code or vocabulary match (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked:, verif*, exit code)
New blocking check p11_ac_vagueness scans AC item lines with fixed lexicon enforcing word boundaries, excluding code spans, and exempting etc. within 30 characters after span end
The vague lexicon was corrected to drop 'clean' prefix-match rule and add word boundaries, reducing false positives from 1-4 across 104 passed plans to zero across 304 passed plans
P6 advisory posture remains unchanged; both new checks are separate DET implementations rather than promotions within P6, with updated P6 lexicon for surface agreement
Code-span handling records positions on original lines before blanking, preventing lexicon matches inside spans and implementing span-proximity exemption for etc. occurrences
